Celebration Layered Vegetable Pie

A large layered vegetable pie designed for parser performance testing.

Deep nested note for DOM depth measurement.

Ingredients

  • 500 g flour
  • 250 g cold butter
  • 120 ml ice water
  • 2 tsp salt
  • 1 egg
  • 400 g potatoes
  • 300 g carrots
  • 250 g zucchini
  • 250 g mushrooms
  • 200 g spinach
  • 2 red onions
  • 4 cloves garlic
  • 200 g feta cheese
  • 150 g hard cheese
  • 100 ml cream
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 tbsp butter
  • 1 tsp thyme
  • 1 tsp oregano
  • 1 tsp paprika
  • 1 tsp ground cumin
  • 1 bunch parsley
  • 1 bunch dill
  • 2 tbsp breadcrumbs
  • 1 tbsp sesame seeds
  • 1 tbsp pumpkin seeds
  • 1 lemon zest
  • 1 tsp mustard
  • 2 tbsp sour cream
  • 1 tsp honey
  • 1 pinch nutmeg
  • 1 pinch black pepper
  • 1 pinch chili flakes
  • 3 tomatoes
  • 1 bell pepper
  • 100 g peas
  • 100 g corn
  • 80 g olives
  • 60 g capers
  • 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar

Instructions

  1. Sift flour into a wide bowl and mix it with salt.
  2. Cut cold butter into cubes and rub it into the flour.
  3. Add ice water gradually until the dough comes together.
  4. Wrap the dough and chill it for at least thirty minutes.
  5. Slice potatoes, carrots, zucchini, mushrooms and onions.
  6. Cook potatoes and carrots until they are just tender.
  7. Saute mushrooms, onion and garlic in olive oil.
  8. Wilt spinach in the pan and squeeze out extra liquid.
  9. Mix cream, egg, mustard, honey and spices in a bowl.
  10. Combine herbs, cheeses and breadcrumbs for the filling.
  11. Roll out two thirds of the dough for the base crust.
  12. Place the crust into a deep pie dish and trim the edge.
  13. Layer potatoes, carrots and zucchini over the bottom.
  14. Add mushrooms, spinach, tomatoes and bell pepper.
  15. Scatter peas, corn, olives and capers between layers.
  16. Pour the cream mixture evenly over the vegetables.
  17. Cover the filling with the remaining rolled dough.
  18. Seal the edges and cut several steam vents on top.
  19. Brush the top with egg and sprinkle with seeds.
  20. Bake the pie at 190 degrees until the crust is firm.
  21. Reduce the heat if the top browns too quickly.
  22. Let the pie rest so the layers settle before slicing.
  23. Serve slices with sour cream and lemon zest.
  24. Store leftovers in an airtight container.
  25. Reheat portions in the oven to keep the crust crisp.
